items.statement: For actual C2 V with 0<alpha<=beta global Hessian bounds, eta>0 and beta eta<=1, construct the actual Gibbs-Gaussian augmentation and common Markov conditional kernels R,S, with disintegration R and S_y=(R_y)#(x->2x-y). S_y is the true normalized reflected Gibbs law for W_y(u)=V((y+u)/2)+norm(u-y)^2/(8eta), with C2 regularity and positive integrable weight. For every y, retain one dense closable exact compact-smooth gradient D, fixed before epsilon/input, and derive every positive-epsilon L2 forcing weak solution, ordinary weak gradient/local integrability and all C1 compact weighted volume test equations. No measurable solution selection in y is claimed.
assumptions: E has the same full-space finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel structure, including dimension zero. V is C2 with true all-point/all-direction alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I, alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, eta>0 and beta eta<=1.

The original Gibbs law, genuine independent Gaussian augmentation, selected R,S kernels, reflected W_y, finite positive partition and fixed original gradient D per fiber are derived by the existing actual conditional producer. Neither normalization nor a convenient replacement operator is supplied.

The potential is reflected, with quarter Hessian scaling. The unreflected SPHMC RGO potential/law is different. Existence is fiberwise for every y; no joint measurable resolvent selection, unbounded cost transfer or macroscopic H1/Poincare theorem is asserted.

bindings.boundary: Same actual compact-gradient graph closure admits C1 compact function/gradient pairs; actual positive-epsilon weak resolvent has all C1 compact weighted volume tests and genuine ordinary weak gradient. Actual PBPS reflected conditional R/S law and original fixed D precede epsilon/input. No local H2, global operator-core/Bochner, conditional Poincare/BL, centered epsilon limit, noncompact constant/linear domains, measurable y-selection, SPHMC Hessian lower/full4.1, PBPS hypocoercivity or either complete main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.
